To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) energy harvesting can provide a reliable power source to cognitive D2D communication, (2) cognitive D2D communications achieve acceptable performance under the same outage requirement as for non-cognitive D2D communication and (3) the PSA policy is better for D2D communications than the RSA policy.
the cognitive and energy harvesting based device-to-device communication is feasible in cellular networks and can be used as a reliable alternative to traditional communication systems.
energy harvesting can enable spectrum-efficient and energy-efficient cognitive D2D communication in cellular networks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the performance evaluation of cognitive and energy harvesting-enabled D2D communication, which can be a promising technology for future wireless networks.
the modeling and performance evaluation of cognitive and energy harvesting-enabled D2D communication in cellular networks using stochastic geometry.
the design and analysis of a cognitive D2D communication system, which can be used to enhance the performance of cellular networks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
cognitive D2D communication with energy harvesting is a viable solution to improve the performance of the cellular network in terms of the outage probability of D2D and cell users.

cognitive D2D communications can be a reliable and efficient solution to improve the performance of cellular networks in dense networks, while providing energy-efficient and spectrum-efficient wireless communication.
cognitive D2D communication with energy harvesting can provide acceptable performance for both the D2D and the cellular users.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

cognitive D2D communication with energy harvesting can be an effective solution for improving the performance of D2D users, while the performance of cellular users is almost the same as that for the non-cognitively accessed cellular network.
the PSA policy is a good choice when both the cellular and D2D networks are in dense deployments and the D2D network requires a high reliability, which is the case in most of the applications.
energy harvesting and cognitive channel access improve the performance of D2D users while maintaining acceptable performance for cellular users.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cognitive and energy harvesting can be combined to achieve energy-efficient and spectrum-efficient wireless communications.
cognitive and energy harvesting can be used to enable D2D communication in cellular networks, which can provide a significant improvement in the overall network performance.

energy harvesting can provide a reliable and energy-efficient alternative to the power cognitive D2Ds in cellular networks, while cognitive channel access can improve the performance of both D2D and the cellular users.
